name: Manual tests (people + real phones)
how: Run on a real phone, then log the result on this page.

cases.title: Grandparent finds the newest photo and comments
cases.steps: Hand your phone to a grandparent with the prototype open as their name. Ask them to find the newest photo and leave a comment. Don't help.
cases.expected: Done in under a minute with no help.

cases.title: Someone can tell who sees a post
cases.steps: Show an adult one of your posts. Ask: who can see this?
cases.expected: They answer correctly from the screen alone.

cases.title: Larger text is readable at arm's length
cases.steps: As a grandparent, turn on Larger text in Me. Hold the phone at arm's length.
cases.expected: Captions and comments readable without glasses (or with their usual pair).

cases.title: New circle end to end
cases.steps: Make a circle, add 2 people, share a photo only to it, then switch Viewing as to someone outside it.
cases.expected: Only the 2 people see it; the outsider sees nothing.

cases.title: Install from TestFlight link on iPhone
cases.steps: Open the TestFlight public link on an iPhone that has never had Hearth.
cases.expected: Installed and signed in by text link in under 3 minutes. Blocked until build #1.

cases.title: Android, no app: invite link opens web viewer
cases.steps: Text an invite link to an Android phone without the app. Open it.
cases.expected: Photos show in the browser; no app or password needed.

cases.title: iPhone to Android photo arrives full quality
cases.steps: Post from an iPhone to a circle with an Android grandparent who chose Text message link.
cases.expected: Text arrives within a minute; photo opens sharp, not an MMS thumbnail.

cases.title: 60-second video over cellular
cases.steps: On cellular (Wi-Fi off), share a 60s video.
cases.expected: Uploads in under 30s and plays on an older phone.

cases.title: Location removed from photos
cases.steps: Share a photo taken with location on. Download it on another phone and check its info.
cases.expected: No GPS location in the file.

cases.title: Removed person loses access on their own phone
cases.steps: Remove someone from a circle while they have the post open.
cases.expected: Gone for them within 10 minutes; they can't reopen it.

cases.title: Co-parent separation with real accounts
cases.steps: Two real households. Co-parent opens every screen.
cases.expected: They never see the other side's circles, relatives, or posts not shared with them.

cases.title: Email digest arrives and links work
cases.steps: Set a tester to Daily email digest; post 2 photos.
cases.expected: One email that evening; links open the right photos.
